items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee only responds to the interviewer's description of Everett Johnson with 'You know, a whole lot has to do with who chooses who.' There is no first-person statement indicating a personal relationship, collaboration, or direct interaction between Gene Ramey and Everett Johnson.

ctx.x: I thought so. He was in there when Hamp (phonetic) had some of his better bands, after the original band, you know.
